novel_features.name: Term-by-term planner
novel_features.description: Build a program's full semester-by-semester plan with per-term and cumulative units, expanding required courses and 'choose one of' options.
novel_features.rationale: Requires walking the synced program-map's terms and opportunities and rolling up min/max units locally — no single ProgramMapper API call returns a units-totaled plan.
novel_features.why_it_matters: When an agent is asked to build a 2-year academic plan, this returns the whole term structure with units in one structured call instead of paging a UI.
novel_features.group: Plan & compare from a local catalog

novel_features.name: Cross-program compare
novel_features.description: Show two programs side by side: shared courses, unique courses, and per-program units totals.
novel_features.rationale: Requires a SQLite join across program, map, opportunity, and course tables; the web app can only show one map at a time.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Lets a student or agent decide between two programs by the actual course overlap and unit cost, not prose.
novel_features.group: Plan & compare from a local catalog

novel_features.name: Catalog-year diff
novel_features.description: Diff a program's current map against a prior catalog year (2019-2025) and report added, removed, and changed courses plus unit deltas.
novel_features.rationale: Joins two locally-synced map snapshots; the ProgramMapper UI has no diff view.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Answers 'did my program's requirements change since the catalog year I started under?' without manual side-by-side reading.
novel_features.group: Plan & compare from a local catalog

novel_features.name: Course-to-program reverse lookup
novel_features.description: List every program and map at the synced college whose term plan includes a given course.
novel_features.rationale: A reverse index over local opportunity-to-course rows; the API and UI only navigate program-to-map-to-course, never the reverse.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Answers a counselor's 'which programs require this course?' in one call instead of opening every map.

novel_features.name: Bottleneck courses
novel_features.description: Rank courses across the synced college by how many program maps require them and by units, surfacing high-leverage and high-load courses.
novel_features.rationale: Aggregates the local opportunity-to-course index; ProgramMapper exposes no aggregation endpoint.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Shows advisors which courses unlock the most programs so scheduling and tutoring effort goes where it matters.

novel_features.name: Cross-college search
novel_features.description: Full-text search programs and courses across every synced college at once, offline.
novel_features.rationale: FTS5 over the local mirror; the ProgramMapper UI searches one college at a time with no cross-college view.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Finds a program or course by keyword across many colleges in one query instead of visiting each college's site.

novel_features.name: Transfer rollup
novel_features.description: Combine a program's CSU/UC linked transfer colleges and linked program maps into one view.
novel_features.rationale: Joins local linked-programs and linked-transfer-colleges rows; the UI shows transfer targets one at a time.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Gives an agent the full set of transfer destinations for a program in one structured response.

narrative.headline: Every California Community College's program maps - degrees, courses, transfer paths, and careers - in one scriptable CLI with an offline SQLite catalog and term-by-term planning no other ProgramMapper tool has.
narrative.value_prop: Program Pathways Mapper publishes the official 'how to finish your degree' roadmaps for hundreds of California community colleges, but only through a click-heavy, one-college-at-a-time web app with no API key and no export. This CLI mirrors a college's full catalog into local SQLite, then lets you - or an AI advisor - search across colleges, build a term-by-term plan with units rollups, compare two programs, find every program that requires a course, and diff catalog years. Offline, scriptable, and agent-native.

quickstart.comment: Confirm the CLI is wired up - no API key needed (the data is public).
Resolve a college to its active site-content id.
Download the college's full catalog (programs, maps, courses) into local SQLite.
Search the mirrored catalog offline for matching programs.
Build the term-by-term plan (program id from the search results).

troubleshoots.symptom: Commands return 'no local mirror' or empty results
troubleshoots.fix: Run 'programmapper-pp-cli mirror <college>' first to populate the local SQLite catalog.
The ProgramMapper WAF throttles bursts per IP; the CLI uses a browser-fingerprinted client and paces requests - retry after a short pause, or lower concurrency.
Pass the full URL including scheme, e.g. https://la-mission.programmapper.ws (not just the hostname).

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI to query California Community College academic catalogs programmatically: resolve a college, mirror its programs/courses/maps offline, search across colleges, build term-by-term degree plans with unit totals, compare programs, find which programs require a course, diff catalog years, and pull CSU/UC transfer and career data. It is the right tool when an agent or script needs structured, joinable academic-pathway data that the ProgramMapper web app only exposes one click at a time.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI to register for classes or submit enrollment - it is read-only public catalog data, not a student information system.
Do not use it to fetch official transcripts, grades, or any protected student records - ProgramMapper carries no student data.
Do not use it for colleges outside California or outside the ProgramMapper network - it only covers CA community colleges in the registry.
Do not treat course requisite text as a structured prerequisite graph - requisites are free-text descriptions, not machine edges.

recipes.title: Mirror a college, then plan a degree
recipes.explanation: Cache L.A. Mission programs, maps, and courses locally, then run plan/compare/course-programs offline.

recipes.title: Narrow a deeply nested plan for an agent
recipes.explanation: Program maps are deeply nested; --select pulls only the term, course title, and units so an agent isn't flooded with the full map payload.

recipes.title: Find which programs require a course
recipes.explanation: Reverse-lookup every program at the mirrored college whose plan includes the course - impossible in the web UI.

recipes.title: See what changed since your start year
recipes.explanation: Diff the current Vocational Nursing map against the 2023 catalog to spot added, removed, or changed courses.

recipes.title: Compare two programs head to head
recipes.explanation: Show shared vs. unique courses and total units for two programs side by side.
